title: Apache RulesSet allocation lacks an APR config-pool cleanup binding
protocol: Apache configuration-pool lifecycle and graceful restart
profile: resulting master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697, tree-identical to final PR #183 head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118
trust_boundary: trusted Apache operator configuration and process lifecycle; no attacker-controlled source or supported attacker-facing boundary has been established
sink: the historical Parent-master allocation path did not bind a heap-allocated RulesSet to APR configuration-pool destruction; resulting master now registers that cleanup
summary: Parent master had allocated a per-directory RulesSet without APR-pool cleanup; the retained baseline APR harness aborted with exit 134 at apache_rules_set_cleanup.c:205. PR #183 was merged at 2026-07-29T11:14:45Z as master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697. That master tree is byte-identical to final PR head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118, and a detached resulting-master worktree passed make check-apache-ruleset-cleanup (five Python contracts plus the native GCC APR harness). All 14 exact-SHA master workflows succeeded. The original APR failure no longer reproduces and its direct legitimate control passes, so the finding is verified. It is not closed: the broader live Apache configuration/readiness/phase-2/SIGUSR1 sequence was not rerun on resulting master.
summary_de: Parent-master hatte ein Per-Directory-RulesSet ohne APR-Pool-Cleanup alloziert; der zurückgehaltene Baseline-APR-Harness brach mit Exit 134 bei apache_rules_set_cleanup.c:205 ab. PR #183 wurde am 2026-07-29T11:14:45Z als Master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 gemergt. Dessen Master-Tree ist byteidentisch mit dem finalen PR-Head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118, und ein detached resulting-master-Worktree bestand make check-apache-ruleset-cleanup (fünf Python-Contracts plus nativer GCC-APR-Harness). Alle 14 diesem SHA zugeordneten Master-Workflows waren erfolgreich. Der ursprüngliche APR-Fehler reproduziert nicht mehr und sein direkter Legitimate-Control besteht, daher ist das Finding verified. Es ist nicht closed: die breitere Live-Apache-Konfigurations-/Readiness-/Phase-2-/SIGUSR1-Sequenz wurde nicht auf resultierendem Master erneut ausgeführt.
observed_behavior: At Parent master 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7, msc_hook_create_config_directory assigns cnf->rules_set = msc_create_rules_set() but does not register an msc_rules_cleanup callback. The retained baseline APR harness exits 134 while asserting native_cleanup_calls == 1. Final PR #183 head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118 adds msc_rules_set_cleanup and apr_pool_cleanup_register immediately after the non-null RulesSet guard. It was merged as Parent master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 with the same tree c4d08e66d9b1929f4a56c81f3d5a021ea6ce4ef0. On a detached exact-master worktree, make check-apache-ruleset-cleanup passed five Python contracts and the native GCC APR harness.
observed_behavior_de: Auf Parent-master 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7 weist msc_hook_create_config_directory cnf->rules_set = msc_create_rules_set() zu, registriert aber keinen msc_rules_cleanup-Callback. Der zurückgehaltene Baseline-APR-Harness endet mit Exit 134, während native_cleanup_calls == 1 erwartet wird. Der finale PR-#183-Head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118 ergänzt msc_rules_set_cleanup und apr_pool_cleanup_register unmittelbar nach dem Non-Null-RulesSet-Guard. Er wurde als Parent-master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 mit demselben Tree c4d08e66d9b1929f4a56c81f3d5a021ea6ce4ef0 gemergt. In einem detached Exact-Master-Worktree bestand make check-apache-ruleset-cleanup fünf Python-Contracts und den nativen GCC-APR-Harness.
expected_behavior: A RulesSet created for one Apache configuration generation is released exactly once when that generation's APR configuration pool is destroyed, while the configured rules remain usable for the normal active-generation lifetime.
expected_behavior_de: Ein für eine Apache-Konfigurationsgeneration erzeugtes RulesSet wird genau einmal freigegeben, wenn der APR-Konfigurationspool dieser Generation zerstört wird, während die konfigurierten Regeln während der normalen Lebenszeit der aktiven Generation nutzbar bleiben.
impact: Without the binding, retired configuration generations can retain RulesSets across graceful restarts and contribute to process-memory growth or availability degradation. The lifecycle ownership flaw is validated by the baseline/candidate harness pair and native configuration/restart controls. No attacker-triggerable path, externally exploitable memory-safety claim, or release blocker has been established.
impact_de: Ohne die Bindung können ausgemusterte Konfigurationsgenerationen RulesSets über Graceful-Restarts hinweg zurückhalten und zu Prozessspeicherwachstum oder Verfügbarkeitsbeeinträchtigung beitragen. Der Lifecycle-Ownership-Fehler ist durch das Baseline-/Kandidaten-Harness-Paar und native Konfigurations-/Restart-Controls validiert. Es wurde weder ein von Angreifern auslösbarer Pfad noch eine extern ausnutzbare Memory-Safety-Behauptung oder ein Release-Blocker belegt.
preconditions: The Parent Apache connector is built and loaded by Apache.
A non-null RulesSet is created for a per-directory configuration generation.
Apache eventually destroys or clears the APR configuration pool, including on graceful restart.
reproduction: Inspect Parent master 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7: connectors/apache/src/msc_config.c creates cnf->rules_set without a RulesSet-specific apr_pool_cleanup_register call.

Run the retained APR cleanup harness against the baseline master source. It aborts at ci/checks/connectors/apache/apache_rules_set_cleanup.c:205 because native_cleanup_calls is 0 rather than 1, with exit 134.
Run the candidate GCC harness. It passes the exactly-once and failure-path ownership controls after registering the callback immediately after successful RulesSet creation.
Run the private Apache HTTP/1.1 control, send SIGUSR1, repeat readiness, and terminate the private server. The retained log shows restart and clean shutdown.

root_cause: The historical adapter-owned Parent source reflected the upstream baseline before 5ea3fc9da876195706375cf35f321de2a1f35ce1 and created a RulesSet without binding its heap lifetime to the APR configuration pool. PR #183 corrected that path with a callback that invokes msc_rules_cleanup and registration after the successful non-null allocation guard. The distinct name_for_debug strdup lifetime remains separately tracked by FND-PARENT-0067.
root_cause_de: Der historische adaptereigene Parent-Source spiegelte die Upstream-Baseline vor 5ea3fc9da876195706375cf35f321de2a1f35ce1 und erzeugte ein RulesSet, ohne seine Heap-Lebenszeit an den APR-Konfigurationspool zu binden. PR #183 korrigierte diesen Pfad mit einem Callback, der msc_rules_cleanup aufruft, sowie einer Registrierung nach dem erfolgreichen Non-Null-Allocation-Guard. Die getrennte name_for_debug-strdup-Lebenszeit bleibt durch FND-PARENT-0067 verfolgt.
proposed_remediation: Retain the minimal RulesSet cleanup callback, APR registration, and focused regression harness now on resulting master. Before any closed disposition, run the broader live Apache configuration/readiness/phase-2/SIGUSR1 sequence on exact master. Do not fold the independent name_for_debug leak into this correction without a separate lifecycle-safe ownership decision.
proposed_remediation_de: Den minimalen RulesSet-Cleanup-Callback, die APR-Registrierung und den fokussierten Regressions-Harness auf dem resultierenden Master beibehalten.
